text: On the records cap: "the other end of the scale has weight. we don't want the agent having to load up hundreds of 40 line docs. What is a record? a record of what, a claim, a topic? what would be best for an agent to want to read? if topic then it definitely may need more than 40 lines." Ruling adopted: a record is one topic, whole; length is what the topic needs; then amended in session: "make the trip wire 100 lines, it either is a juicy topic or two topics if it is over 100 lines. 150 line cap."
